source_records.body: In Juniper, the pond plaques is independent of the Pebble pond survey. For Juniper pond plaques, use large lettering on pond plaques. I want the Juniper pond plaques kept in planning until its own review.
For the next step on Pebble pond survey, label unknown depths as unknown. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
Fictional local record for Pebble pond survey. The first preview contains the requested survey legend. This record covers a local preview only.

I accept the survey legend for Pebble pond survey. I close Pebble pond survey. While closing Pebble pond survey, I do not accept the Pebble winter map. At this review, cancel the Pebble winter map. There is no time for the winter map in this review window.
I believe sending for Pebble pond survey is complete because the local preview finished.

For Pebble, open the pond survey work item. For Pebble pond survey, keep uncertain readings visible because the next survey must revisit them. At this opening meeting, Pebble pond survey is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Pebble pond survey sets depth unit to inches. The winter map is a separate follow-up to Pebble pond survey.
Correction for Pebble pond survey: use depth unit of centimeters, replacing my initial value of inches. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Pebble pond survey.

Reopen the Pebble winter map because a new inlet appeared after the survey. The Pebble winter map must mark the shallow inlet. The accepted Pebble pond survey stays closed while the winter map is open.
I will put the Pebble pond survey preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 3.
This chat continues the same Pebble pond survey work item opened in the first chat. The Pebble pond survey constraint to keep uncertain readings visible still applies.
Fictional status record for Juniper pond plaques. Juniper pond plaques remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

For Pebble, you can send the map only after Sela signs the inlet sketch. For Pebble, permission to send the map also requires that the depth sheet passes reconciliation. Both conditions for permission to send the map in Pebble are necessary because an unmarked inlet misleads the survey crew.

Fictional execution receipt for Pebble pond survey. The recorded command exported a map to the local proof folder for Pebble pond survey. The recorded command did not perform sending for Pebble pond survey. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
